name: category-encoders-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is category_encoders, a library of scikit-learn-style transformers that
encode categorical variables as numeric features.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the category_encoders package together with the documentation that describes it: its docstrings, the docs/source reference pages and guides, the README and the top-level example scripts.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation includes the in-package
docstrings and their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a
comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be
